# Test fixtures

This directory stores small, committed PDF fixtures used by workspace tests and demo validation.

Expected fixture set:

- `hello.pdf` — valid minimal 1-page PDF under 10 KB
- `500page.pdf` — valid minimal 500-page blank PDF under 500 KB
- `bookmarks.pdf` — valid 7-page PDF with 3 outline roots × 2 children each under 50 KB

Future fixtures should stay deterministic, tiny, and safe to redistribute.
